policy: CLI-first; MCP only for persistent endpoint workflows.

bridges.purpose: Durable shared memory and prior-decision lookup. Direct CLI wrappers are the universal baseline; MCP is optional for live tool endpoints.
Long-output routing and indexed context continuity.
Skill creation, packaging, upload, and install workflows.
Persistent browser/CDP automation when graphical rendering is not required.

rules: Use skill-router skill <name> for on-demand skill bodies.
Do not copy the full skills corpus into always-loaded instructions.
Do not run MCP bridges for simple one-shot CLI work.
Default install keeps persistent MCP bridge scheduled tasks disabled; enable only for explicit endpoint workflows.
Keep secrets in the central Universal AI Stack env, not in MCP manifests.
Use Save-UniversalAIMemory.ps1 and Search-UniversalAIMemory.ps1 for cross-client memory when MCP is not active.
MemPalace is authoritative durable memory; GBrain is the structured searchable mirror and should use the local qwen3-embedding-0.6b service for vectors.
Context Mode is scratch/context continuity only; do not store durable facts there when MemPalace is available.
